newsitem.title: USA: Castle Energy to buy back 500,000 more shrs.
newsitem.headline: Castle Energy to buy back 500,000 more shrs.

text.p: Castle Energy Corp said Monday it has increased its share repurchase authorization to as many as 1.5 million shares, up from one million shares.
The company also said it has extended the period of the repurchase program until the end of October, from April.
Castle said it has repurchased 865,700 shares, or 12.9 percent of the shares outstanding since it began the stock repurchase program in October, 1996.

It added that so far, only $2 million has been provided from borrowed funds for the stock buy backs. Radnor said it excpects that cash flow will provide most of the funds for future open market repurchases.
